instruction: Please export the opened LibreOffice Calc file as a tab-delimited text file (.txt format) and save it to the Desktop with the same base filename.

metadata.explanation: Task requires exporting Excel file as tab-delimited text format. Evaluator comprehensively verifies: (1) file exists with proper tab-delimited format, (2) minimum 2 rows and 9 columns, (3) key cell value at row 1, col 8 (0-indexed) equals '757504' (Total income from original Excel row 2, column I). This ensures complete data export verification.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts comprehensive data: row_count, col_count, multiple strategic cells from different regions (0_0, 1_8, 1_0, 0_8, 2_0, last_row), and validates tab-delimited format
Metric implements robust structural checks: min_rows=40 and min_cols=10 ensure substantial data export (not just partial)
Metric enforces diversity requirements: requires cells from >=3 different rows and >=2 different columns, preventing false positives from truncated exports
Metric validates data quality: checks that >=60% of extracted cells are non-empty, detecting corrupted/incomplete exports
Expected cell value (1_8='757504') corresponds to actual data from original Excel file (Total income, row 2, column I)
File format validation ensures proper tab-delimited structure (has_tabs check)
Minor weakness: Only 1 cell value specified in expected.cells, but metric's diversity and quality checks provide reasonable assurance of export completeness
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider adding 2-3 more cell checks in expected.rules.cells for stronger verification (e.g., 0_0 for header, 2_0 for data row, last_row cell for completeness)
Optional: Add metadata documenting actual Excel dimensions to justify min_rows=40 and min_cols=10 thresholds
